notes: Gaia NSS acceleration solution identifies an astrometric non-single star; not a measured 0.28466d orbit and not proof that transit-like signal is binary.
TIC870703559 parallax and proper motion differ strongly from target, so it is background blend rather than established physical companion.
Gaia propagation uses linear five-parameter proper motion; target has acceleration solution so these positions are approximate, not precision predictions.
Equal-aperture-throughput dilution assumes target plus one contaminant; actual aperture/PRF throughput and all neighboring flux require pixel modelling.
No matching catalog signal does not establish novelty; catalog coordinates have different epochs and literature may be incomplete.
